title: Gradation on a 40 × 40 mm fill (default pattern)
description: The 40 × 40 mm fill at 0°, under sewing off, with PE-DESIGN's default gradation (pattern 1, Max 53 %, Min 5 %, steps 53/47/41/35/29/23/17/11/5): the rows thin linearly from the start edge; count within 15 % of PE-DESIGN's, no trim or jump.

references.make: On a 100 × 100 mm Design Page draw a 40 × 40 mm square from (10, 10) to (50, 50) mm. Line Not Sewn; region Fill Stitch, Direction Manual 0°, Under sewing unticked, Density 4.5, Gradation ticked with pattern 1, Max 53 %, Min 5 % (steps 53/47/41/35/29/23/17/11/5 %), Blend off, direction 0. Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).
